name: Monotonic Stack
summary: A stack of elements that are waiting for an answer. Each new value resolves the waiting elements it is greater (or smaller) than, so no element is ever examined more than twice.
signal: next greater, next smaller, previous greater, previous smaller, histogram boundaries
mentalModel: The stack holds elements that are waiting. A new value answers whoever it dominates.
recognitionRules: The question asks for the next / previous greater or smaller element.
Some elements are waiting for an answer that a later element will provide.
You need the largest rectangle in a histogram, or similar boundary problems.
The input arrives one element at a time and each element may be answered later.
Nested loops are needed in the brute force version: O(n^2) becomes O(n).
template: while stack is not empty and input[stack.top] is dominated by value:
resolve(stack.pop())          // value is the answer for this index
invariant: The stack maintains a strictly monotonic order of the values it holds.
